## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: May 10, 2026 - Jul 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _what u up 2 x_, May 10, 2026, 1/5: "Used to use this app 3 years ago and it was brilliant and nothing behind paywall! Just logged in today to find everything is behind a paywall! Deleted my account and removed the app! Do not recommend for this reason."
            2. _Janis’s pretty good opinions_, Jul 23, 2026, 3/5: "Paywalls. An app like this shouldn’t have any paywalls to begin with but does and it’s really dumb in my opinion because it is a tracker for recovery but you can only track 2 things unless you cough up money. I like the layout,format, it has good chunk of options, but the paywall is just sad. I liked the app so much I felt good enough with it to want to track more but cannot. There’s also like two other paywalls lurking in it, the app is just mid and does the bare minimum."
            3. _Nickname that isnt taken omfg_, May 13, 2026, 3/5: "Ive had this app since 2021 and its a great way to track. The reason Im writing a review now is because one thing that I used to love to use was the community feature. It would let you talk to people going through the same thing as you, at the same point in sobriety however now that community tab is behind a paywall. There wasnt much of a paywall when i first got this app but now every feature is behind it. It feels unfair because the reason i got this app was to talk to other people, it made me feel like i wasnt alone in what i was doing/going through. It was an amazing feature it just sucks that its behind a paywall now hence the reason for the 3 stars"
